newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Coconut Oil-Improved supplies to keep prices soft.
newsitem.headline: Coconut Oil-Improved supplies to keep prices soft.

text.p: Coconut oil prices are expected to drift lower or remain steady this week due to rising supply from both the Philippines and Indonesia, Manila vegetable oil traders said on Monday.
But traders said post-Easter holiday blues and ample supplies in both the European and U.S. markets would keep prices in a narrow range.
"I expect prices to drift lower due to rising output from both the Philippines and Indonesia," a senior trader told Reuters.
Traders said increased exports from both countries had kept stocks in Rotterdam at "comfortable levels" in the past several weeks.
Coconut oil stocks in Rotterdam as of March 24 dipped to 23,132 tonnes as against 24,033 in the previous week.
Last week, the coconut oil market was inactive due to the Easter holiday and a vegetable oil convention in the United States.

"Most of the players are back from the convention. I expect activity to pick-up slowly as the market seeks direction from other vegetable oil markets, " another trader at a Philippine coconut oil miller said.
